findings_resolved_same_run.finding: Optional productoVarianteId caused TS18048 in checkout validation on the first candidate.

findings_resolved_same_run.finding: Introducing physical variant keys made previously persisted unambiguous legacy modeloClave tuples fail rehydration, leaving demo checkout empty and breaking two Fase 6 Playwright cases.
findings_resolved_same_run.root_cause: restaurarCarrito matched only the new variant:<productoVarianteId> key even though v2 persisted carts from the previous representation store the legacy [modeloId, modeloNombre, marcaNombre] tuple.
findings_resolved_same_run.recovery: Restore exact current keys first; otherwise upgrade a legacy tuple only when it maps to exactly one available physical variant. Ambiguous legacy tuples fail closed instead of selecting an arbitrary sibling variant.

acceptance_assessment.variant_identity: New carts use exact productoVarianteId-derived keys and checkout carries productoVarianteId end to end.
acceptance_assessment.legacy_safety: Existing unambiguous persisted carts can be upgraded to the physical variant identity; ambiguous legacy tuples are discarded rather than conflated.
acceptance_assessment.privacy: Persisted cart references remain minimal and contain no price, stock, customer or payment data.
